press_release: The status frame carries a held-state bitmap, not press/release events. For each parsed key the handler computes ((mask & keyMask) == keyMask) (0x8b08a8/0x8b08b0, repeated for every key) and stores a bool on the state; 'pressed' = bit 1, 'released' = bit 0. It then compares the new booleans with the previously stored ones (long cmp chain 0x8b16e8-0x8b1938) and calls setState only when at least one changed (0x8b1a9c setState) - i.e. press/release is derived by edge detection against the previous frame, and a repeated identical frame produces no UI update. Analog axes additionally use an absolute-difference threshold of 327.68 raw units (double 0x40747ae147ae147b, pp+0x4e068) before setState (0x8b1ad8-0x8b1b7c).
key_id_extraction: mask = big-endian uint32 of frame bytes [3][4][5][6]; key k is pressed iff (mask & keyMask(k)) == keyMask(k) with keyMask = 1 << id.
